items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: I don't know if everybody ever mentioned about Joe Johnson. Joe Johnson. He's a trumpet player.

ctx.x: Well, he used to talk about Joe Johnson.
I don't know if everybody ever mentioned about Joe Johnson. Joe Johnson. He's a trumpet player.
I've heard of him, don't know much about him. He played on front of him. No.
